projections.text: Jamie implemented and maintained Talks Not Raids, giving the coalition's demand for transparency and alternatives to raids a durable public campaign site. The campaign concerned Multi-Agency Response to Community Hotspots (M.A.R.C.H.), an NYPD-led inspection program. The Council later required semiannual reports and 30 days' advance notice, with criminal-investigation and serious health-or-safety exceptions. The Office of Nightlife reports that the City replaced M.A.R.C.H. with direct engagement before enforcement in 2023.

supports: Jamie's Talks Not Raids site implementation and maintenance

boundaries: The sequence connects Jamie's implementation work, collective advocacy, Council enactment, and later City action without claiming that one caused the next.
